mapper.select: select g.*, u.nickname from grade g join user u on g.user_idx = u.idx where g.type = #{type} and g.status = 0 order by g.written_date
select count(*) > 0 from grade where user_idx = #{userIdx} and type = #{type} and update_level = #{updateLevel} and status = 0
mapper.insert: insert into grade (user_idx, type, update_level) values (#{userIdx}, #{type}, #{updateLevel})
mapper.update: update grade set status = 1, approval_date = now() where user_idx = #{userIdx} and type = #{type} and status = 0
